# Cncf Permify Reviewer

Review Permify using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Permify is an open-source authorization as a service inspired by Google Zanzibar, designed to build and manage fine-grained and scalable authorization systems for any application.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
